WA.registrationBody: Washington State Department of Labor & Industries
WA.advertisingRule: RCW 18.27.100 requires the current contractor registration number in advertising that shows the contractor's name or address
WA.advertisingGuidance: Narrow exemptions exist, but the practical recommendation is to carry the number on everything including the vehicle wrap
WA.verificationPitch: Invite homeowners to verify the license with L&I. Inviting verification converts better than claiming to be licensed

terminologyTraps.why: A backflow preventer protects potable water from contamination. A backwater valve stops sewage flowing back into the home. Using them interchangeably loses credibility with any homeowner who has already researched the problem
